gloss: transfer; reassignment to a new post

definitions.gloss: transfer; reassignment to a different position or location
definitions.explanation: The act of being transferred to a new post, office, or location within the same organization. Commonly used for government officials, teachers, and company employees.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、{転任|てんにん}することになった。
{校長|こうちょう}が{他|ほか}の{学校|がっこう}に{転任|てんにん}した。
examples.english: The principal was transferred to another school.

examples.japanese: {転任|てんにん}の{挨拶|あいさつ}として、{職場|しょくば}の{全員|ぜんいん}にメールを{送|おく}った。
examples.english: As a farewell greeting for my transfer, I sent an email to everyone at the office.

notes:
Compound of {転|てん} (change, move) and {任|にん} (assignment, post). Often used with する to form a verb meaning "to be transferred."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転任|てんにん}する: to be transferred
- {転任|てんにん}の{挨拶|あいさつ}: transfer farewell greeting
- {転任|てんにん}{届|とどけ}: transfer notification form
- {転任|てんにん}{先|さき}: new post/location after transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転勤|てんきん}: job transfer — used specifically for company employees being relocated
- {異動|いどう}: personnel change — broader term covering any change in position, department, or role
- {赴任|ふにん}: taking up a new post — focuses on going to and starting at the new location
- {左遷|させん}: demotion-transfer — transfer to a lesser position, often punitive
